title: Asteroids · Atari 8-bit Native Development
summary: Native selected-US-XEX mode and multiplayer rules with original masks, alternating source callbacks, thrust, shots, splits, waves, UFOs, score/lives and source-state saves. POKEY/OS startup, colors, audio and raster timing remain unqualified.
notes: Native ARM64 development reconstruction of this selected edition; no source CPU executes. This is not a completed faithful rewrite.
Original prepared rule tables and graphics are required and remain local, excluded from Git. Missing or changed data blocks launch.
Native source/version-bound saves restore paused. Original behavior/visual/audio comparisons, physical Fusion Pro transitions and sustained M1 Air /8GB acceptance remain unfinished.

Run Tools/decode_asteroids8bit.py after Tools/prepare_asteroids.py. Startup uses a visibly labelled finite synthetic sample stream and zero fractions. Development pacing is60 source callbacks/sec; it is not qualified original timing.
keyboard: Player1 arrows + Space; player2 W A S D + F
Player3 I J K L + O; player4 T G B H + V
Up thrusts; down uses the selected special control; Escape pauses
controller: Stick / D-pad: turn, thrust and selected special control
A / RB: fire; X: special control; B / Menu: pause
One controller follows the alternating active player or player1; other players use keyboard adapters
